original_value: This paper introduces a new urban point cloud dataset for automatic segmentation and classification acquired by mobile laser scanning (MLS). We describe how the dataset is obtained from acquisition to post-processing and labeling. This dataset can be used to train pointwise classification algorithms; however, given that a great attention has been paid to the split between the different objects, this dataset can also be used to train the detection and segmentation of objects. The dataset consists of around [Formula: see text] of MLS point cloud acquired in two cities. The number of points and range of classes mean that it can be used to train deep-learning methods. In addition, we show some results of automatic segmentation and classification. The dataset is available at: http://caor-mines-paristech.fr/fr/paris-lille-3d-dataset/ .

result.paraphrase: This paper presents a new urban point cloud dataset, acquired by mobile laser scanning (MLS), for automatic segmentation and classification. It explains the full process from data acquisition through post-processing and labeling. The dataset can be used to train pointwise classification algorithms, and because particular care was taken to separate the different objects, it can also support training for object detection and segmentation. It includes approximately [Formula: see text] of MLS point cloud data collected in two cities. The number of points and the range of classes make it suitable for deep-learning methods. We also present some results of automatic segmentation and classification. The dataset is available at: http://caor-mines-paristech.fr/fr/paris-lille-3d-dataset/ .
